figures.subject: smallest singular value against drive for the unpinned and centroid-pinned arms

findings.disposition: folded: a figure revision of the poloidal panel under sub-millisecond-forward-path section 3
findings.summary: The null-flux panel is drawn on the default 14 x 7.2 in canvas with an equal aspect, so the tall portrait cross-section fills only 400 of the rendered 1399 px of width and roughly a third of the canvas is empty on each side. The mode's contour detail renders about a third of the width available and the figure spends most of its area on white; a canvas sized to the subject would draw the same contours markedly larger at the same page width.

findings.disposition: exempted: the arms' ends are the measurement, the caption names the four condition rows and the stopping drives, and the picture misleads no reader who reads the caption beside it
findings.summary: The grey unpinned arm carries four rows at two well separated drives, about 1.001 and 1.0089, and they are joined by a single straight segment across the 0.0078 of drive between them. That segment is the most salient shape in the figure and reads as a measured smooth decay, where no state exists between the two clusters; the caption's four-row wording bounds it only for a reader who goes to the caption.

findings.disposition: folded: a figure revision separating the arms into small multiples, or annotating the axis as not comparable, under sub-millisecond-forward-path section 3
findings.summary: Both arms share one log axis, so their vertical separation of about two decades is the figure's dominant feature, while the caption states the two matrices differ in size and balancing conventions and that the gap is not a measure of physical improvement. A reader who takes the picture alone reads the pinned arm as a hundredfold conditioning loss, and the axis itself offers no cue that the two series are not commensurable.

item_verdicts.contrast: pass — both figures put their marks and their text on white well above the required contrast; the poloidal panel draws no text.
item_verdicts.data_ink: pass — contours and wall, then two series and their labels, are the only ink in either figure; the poloidal panel spends 71 per cent of its width on white; recorded as a finding, not a hold.
item_verdicts.decoration: pass — neither figure carries a gradient, background fill, grid, frame or drop shadow.
item_verdicts.label_collision: pass — no text is clipped, no text overlaps another text block, and no label sits over the data in either rendered image.
item_verdicts.legibility: pass — both panels read at a glance: the poloidal panel reads as a radial-mode contour image beside its wall, and the singular-value panel reads as two labelled arms on a log scale.
item_verdicts.table_form: pass — neither image depicts information that is naturally a table: one is a spatial field, the other a nine-value log-scale comparison.

readings.captions: Both captions in docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-fold-vertical.html state what each figure shows and add material beyond the title, so neither is a title repeat.
readings.image_0_blank_regions_are_not_missing_da: Every vessel-interior sample point of a 200x300 grid lies inside the convex hull of the receipt's 1741 (r, z) nodes, so the white areas between the drawn levels inside the vessel are between-level areas and not interpolation gaps. This control is why no missing-data finding is recorded against the poloidal panel; checking the absence was what established it.
readings.image_0_matches_the_recorded_state: Recomputed the mode's contour set from the reviewed run's first.json null receipt at the same fifteen equally spaced levels over the same 240-point grid; after mapping wall data extremes onto the measured wall pixels (r 0.9656-2.4342 to x 503-901, z -1.2077-1.1147 to y 675-47), 91 per cent of 1597 predicted contour sample points fall within 3 px of drawn blue ink and the extents agree, so the rendered panel is the receipt's mode image rather than a stale drawing.
readings.image_0_pixels: 1399x720; ink bounding box x 503-902, y 46-675; ink 2.01 per cent of the canvas; palette white 987058 px, #2e6fa8 8060 px, #222222 3821 px, the remainder antialiasing.
readings.image_1_pixels: 1399x720; ink bounding box x 95-1344, y 56-652; ink 1.77 per cent of the canvas; palette white 989420 px, #929292 3309 px (unpinned), #52514e 2807 px (text) and #2e6fa8 882 px (pinned) with antialiasing.
readings.image_1_values_match_the_record: Grey markers sit at about 6.3e-4 at drive 1.001 and at about 5e-6, 1.6e-6 and 1.1e-6 at drive 1.0089, and the blue markers run from about 4e-8 down to 3.3e-8 then up to 1.1e-7 and back to 7.3e-8, which agree with the four unpinned condition rows and the five pinned rows the evidence fragment states.
